nodes.description: Mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances, written by transfer, transferFrom, buy and bless.
Total token supply storage variable returned by totalSupply().
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) of ERC20 allowances.
Owner address set in Ownable constructor and used by onlyOwner.
Fixed initial supply constant assigned in LuckToken constructor.
Caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances and ownership checks.
Payable buy() that mints tokens to msg.sender from the owner balance based on msg.value.
bless() transfers tokens from msg.sender to owner and emits Bless event.
onlyOwner function that sends the whole contract balance to owner via send().
Payable fallback function that forwards the call to buy().
onlyOwner function that transfers contract ownership to newOwner.
ERC20 transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to _to using SafeMath.
ERC20 transferFrom spending allowances and moving tokens from _from to _to.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] to _value.
Decreases the caller allowance for _spender by _subtractedValue.
Increases the caller allowance for _spender by _addedValue.
LuckToken constructor assigning totalSupply_ and the full balance to msg.sender.
SafeMath subtraction with assertion that b <= a.
SafeMath addition with assertion that c >= a.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow assertion.
View function returning totalSupply_.
View function returning balances[_owner].
View function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Ownable constructor setting owner = msg.sender.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function.
balances[owner].sub(_value) in buy(): can revert/underflow if _value exceeds owner balance.
owner.send(address(this).balance) in reclaimEther: external value call, reentrancy-sensitive.
balances[msg.sender].add(_value) in buy(): arithmetic addition guarded by SafeMath assertion.

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes the balances mapping for read and write.
msg.sender determines credit target in buy().
msg.sender is debited in bless().
msg.sender balance is debited in transfer().
msg.sender allowance is consumed in transferFrom().
msg.sender owns the allowance written in approve().
msg.sender allowance is increased in increaseApproval().
msg.sender allowance is decreased in decreaseApproval().
Constructor assigns the full initial supply to msg.sender.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions.
transferOwnership authorization depends on msg.sender through onlyOwner.
transfer reads and writes balances entries.
transferFrom reads and writes balances entries.
buy reads and writes balances entries.
bless reads and writes balances entries.
balanceOf returns an entry of balances.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval writes the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval writes the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
buy debits the owner balance, making owner funds part of the operation.
bless credits the owner balance.
reclaimEther sends funds to owner.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner variable.
onlyOwner reads the owner variable for authorization.
totalSupply() returns totalSupply_.
Constructor copies INITIAL_SUPPLY into totalSupply_ and balances.
_to receives tokens in transfer().
_value is the transferred amount in transfer().
_from is the debited account in transferFrom().
_to is the credited account in transferFrom().
_value is the transferred amount in transferFrom().
_spender is the allowance beneficiary in approve().
_value is the allowance amount in approve().
newOwner becomes the new privileged owner.
_words is emitted in the Bless event.
_value is the blessed amount in bless().
Local _value drives both balance updates in buy().
User-derived _value is subtracted from the owner balance.
Owner balance is the left operand of the subtraction in buy().
User-derived _value is added to the caller balance.
Caller balance is the left operand of the addition in buy().
_subtractedValue drives the allowance decrement.
oldValue caches the allowance before comparison and update.
_addedValue drives the allowance increment.
_owner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf().
reclaimEther sends the balance to the owner address, the external call target.
onlyOwner guards the execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner guards the execution of reclaimEther.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub for the balance decrement.
transfer calls SafeMath.add for the balance increment.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub for balances and allowance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add for the destination balance.
buy calls SafeMath.sub on the owner balance.
buy calls SafeMath.add on the caller balance.
bless calls SafeMath.sub on the caller balance.
bless calls SafeMath.add on the owner balance.
decreaseApproval calls SafeMath.sub when allowance is sufficient.
increaseApproval calls SafeMath.add on the allowance.
Constructor writes the initial balance entry.
reclaimEther reaches the external send to owner.
buy executes the subtraction on the owner balance.
buy executes the addition on the caller balance.
Value-transfer send to owner may re-enter the payable fallback of this contract.
The fallback function forwards execution to buy().
